senses.en_definition: Moreover; even; used to add emphasis or introduce something that goes further than what precedes it.
Instead; on the contrary; even; used to introduce an unexpected contrast or a more extreme outcome than expected.

messages.en: Are you nearly here? You said you were going to take the back road, right?
I did. Thought I could avoid the traffic. It hasn't helped at all—it's even more jammed here.
Oh no. It's okay, I'll head into the shop first. Just text me when you get here.
I've read the chapter on angels. The teacher's going to ask us about their duties tomorrow, right?
Yeah. Let's go over our notes together, then just ask the teacher if there's anything we don't understand.

senses.en_definition: Night; the period between sunset and sunrise, as opposed to daytime.
(Archaic, from Javanese) Wax used in batik to prevent dye from colouring selected areas of fabric.

messages.en: Let's grab dinner at a mamak stall tonight.
Sure. Eight tonight, okay? I finish work at seven.
I'm having such bad luck today. My car broke down, and now my phone's dead too.
Oh no, what a pain. Where are you now? I can come and pick you up.
